attributes.context: It appears in Section 16.7, Proof of Payment Program, of the 2004-2008 MOU between Transport Workers Union, Local 250-A, and the Municipal Transportation Agency, within the Muni-Metro operational provisions.

extraction_text: The Proof of Payment program on Breda cars in revenue service may be modified to include the operation with one operator of up to three (3) cars in the tunnel providing additional service and of two (2) cars per train in revenue service on the street. A Proof of Payment program may be introduced on other Muni Metro equipment after such a program can be introduced safely for passengers and operators.

attributes.context: This subsection is part of Section 16.7 Proof of Payment Program, which permits one-operator operation of multiple Breda cars and introduces the concept of extending a Proof of Payment program to other Muni Metro equipment.

extraction_text: (a) Prior to implementation of a Proof of Payment program on other than Breda cars, the Safety Committee established by Section 21.2 shall address safety and security concerns on the Proof of Payment program.

attributes.context: This subsection is part of Section 16.7 Proof of Payment Program, following the Safety Committee subsections that address safety, security, and operator responsibility guidelines for the Proof of Payment program.

extraction_text: (c) Any operator displaced as a result of a Proof of Payment program shall be reassigned to another operator position, in accordance with provisions of this MOU.
